context: You're at Wyrm's Rock by the Lower City gates and watch Duke Ravengard (Wyll's father) being seized and taken away by Gortash's forces. Mizora taunts the situation, claiming Ravengard has effectively been "relocated" to his death while teasing that she may hold a way to save him. In this version Wyll is not present, so Mizora addresses the player and asks them to meet her in her camp to discuss what can be done. (In related scenes Mizora later offers a bargain in camp that determines whether Ravengard lives or dies.)
